st: Is the future of medicine at a turning point?

sec.p: Biology is complex: a cluster of ever larger atoms (molecules, proteins, RNA, DNA, lipid bilayers, one after another, “alla fiera dell'Est” style).
Partly due to COVID, life expectancy in many countries has stalled (if not sharply collapsed), with the United States overtaken by China!

sec.t: ff.66.3 A decentralised cure against the “powers that be”
sec.p: So what's wrong? Probably a mix of bureaucracy, excessive risk aversion and groups protecting the status quo of the pharmaceutical world's $0.4T market, 0.25% of global GDP, $101T in 2022)
